label: Every state either has F or lacks it: no state lies between the two sides of…, from excluded middle
meaning: Bridge (#401), an instance of excluded middle: the conclusion of the change argument, *Metaphysics* IV.7, 1011b29-1012a1 (STMT-CONTRADICTORY-PAIR-DECIDED-ON-STATES: every state has F or lacks it), is an instance of excluded middle (STMT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE) per state. The proof only instantiates the premise. It connects the change argument's conclusion to the self-evident principle; it says nothing about the change argument's own premises, which the withholder also withholds.
